Weapons Kills with a Matching Subclass Element grant a stack of Death Throes for 11 seconds, up to 5 stacks. All stacks disappear upon buff expiration.

Death Throes grants 50% additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate and 20% Increased Grenade Damage per stack.

On Grenade Ability Use:
Allies within 18(?) metres receive Feel The Flame.

Feel the Flame grants [1000?]% additional Base Grenade Recharge Rate.
Duration is equal to the number of Death Throes stacks multiplied by 2 seconds.
